variants.text: White sedan with a stylized trunk badge and rectangular taillights.
A white sedan featuring rectangular taillights and a badge on the center of the trunk lid with interlocking circular and geometric elements.
White sedan with rectangular taillights on either side of the trunk. The center of the trunk lid features a badge depicting a stylized symbol of interlocking circular and geometric elements.

This is a white sedan. It has a distinctive badge in the middle of the trunk lid that looks like a symbol made of circles and geometric shapes, and it has rectangular taillights on the sides of the trunk.
